stem:
Chirag connects an LED to a cell. The LED has a longer leg and a shorter leg.

Which connection makes the LED glow?

options.text: Longer leg to the negative terminal; shorter leg to the positive terminal.
Longer leg to the positive terminal; shorter leg to the negative terminal.
Both legs joined to the positive terminal.
Either way round, because an LED glows in both directions.

teacher.key_rationale: An LED glows when its longer leg joins the positive terminal and its shorter leg joins the negative terminal.
